note: RE-RECORDED 2026-09-04 BY THE MAINTAINER'S RULING ON page-bytes, AND IT REPLACES THE RECORD OF 2026-08-14. That record was taken at commit 74510c5 on a GitHub Actions runner, an AMD EPYC 7763 under Chrome 151, and 69 commits touching packages/ or tools/browser-budget/src had landed past it, so the budgets gate printed FROM A STALE RECORD beside every browser row and the 204,818 it carried described a page that no longer existed. The ruling was to re-derive page-bytes by the row's own recorded property against a measurement taken again rather than reused, which is the move T062 made when the subject of the two raw rows moved to the published form. THE MEASUREMENT: 223,327 bytes, 48,089 document, 62,594 CSS, 112,644 JS, identical to the byte across all twenty navigations at a standard deviation of zero on each column, which is what this class of figure does. Against the record it replaces the document grew 10,195, the stylesheet 3,012 and the JS 5,302, which is 18,509, and 204,818 plus 18,509 is 223,327 with no unnamed term. TWO OF THE THREE COLUMNS AGREE WITH THE PUBLISHED FORM TO THE BYTE, measured rather than argued: the CSS column is theme-css-raw on this tree and the JS column is client-js-raw on it. THE CAP WAS RE-DERIVED FIRST, in SPEC 20, by this row's own property and not by any rule shared with another row: a navigation sized addition of 2,520 has to fit and a theme.css region the size of the page frame, 3,287, or of the try-it console, 3,669, has to fail. 220 KB does not hold 225,847 and breaks the first half; 222 KB at 227,328 would let 226,614 in unremarked; 221 KB at 226,304 keeps both halves, and the headroom is 2,977. It was never a language question: a page drawing no sample at all measures 214,243 stripped and 214,997 with the section chrome, so the overrun of 6,371 exists at zero languages, and the same page with all fifteen read 229,935. WHICH MACHINE THIS IS AND WHY IT IS NOT THE ONE IT REPLACES: the three byte columns are the figures no processor and no browser major moves, which SPEC 20 records as measured across five processors and now again across two majors, so the quantity this record is being re-taken for is comparable while the wall clock lines are not. They are recorded and not gated for exactly that reason, and the medians here belong to a workstation rather than to a runner. LONG TASKS: a median of 0 over twenty navigations against a cap of 2, on a machine far faster than the runner that read 1, and the count stays the coarse instrument every record before this one called it. Nothing in overBudget: page-bytes is inside the re-derived cap by 2,977 bytes and served-document is 48,089 of 73,728.
